description: CAPOW, published by romulus97, simulates meteorology- and hydrology-driven unit commitment and economic dispatch in California and the Pacific Northwest. Coverage: The documented formulation covers CAISO and Mid-Columbia markets, with hourly outputs for roughly 300 generators and daily hydropower inputs. Source and documentation are publicly accessible through the repository; no model files were downloaded or executed. The licence is MIT. The free cost label refers to repository access; external software or services can have separate costs. Limitations: The authors state that historical hourly price dynamics are poorly reproduced, while daily averages are represented better. Default inter-market flows are statistical; alternatives require reformulation. For catalogue screening, its documented functions support capacity planning, optimisation studies; this is an assessment of possible use, not a claim of validated performance. Related records: No directly related catalogue record was established from the reviewed sources.
